name: [UPDATE📢] Case World
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Case World! 🔥

Unbox rare loot, build your fortune, and become the ultimate Case Master!

🎁 Open free cases to build your cash stack!
📈 Upgrade your case to unlock bigger, rarer rewards.
⚔️ Go head-to-head with players in high-stakes opening duels!
🏦 Deposit your top items into the bank to earn passive interest even offline!
🏆 Climb to the top and flex your net worth to the server!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game for updates!

Note: All items in this game are virtual and hold no real-world monetary value.
